items.html: However, this Tzelem, which clothes in the NHY of Tvuna, was their life and internality; and after their internality, their essence, departed, they remained like dead at the time of the birth of the Tzelem, as explained on the verse “and you shall see them upon the stones”; and afterward they return to live through the Tzelem, which becomes for them life and internality as a loan, for it is indeed only internality for the sake of ZA himself.
